title: SIGKILL after two level-1 acked writes, with one tool step still open

preconditions.notes: A dispatched journal record is acked, then two workspace writes are acked at mseq 1 and 2. No epoch-close record exists yet.

timeline.event: journal dispatched acked; two writes acked
timeline.detail: acked_mseq is 2, one step is open and the newest epoch has no close record
uncatchable: no drain, no epoch close, no manifest rewrite, no WAL fsync
the persisted Running state maps to Recovering with admission closed and boot disposition crash_recovery
every acked mseq is present with the identical mutation, the materialized copy equals the replay, no torn tail is truncated
admission opens only in Running (budgets.md section 1)
reconcile lists exactly the interrupted step and abandons none

notes: The acked prefix is the only safe assertion bound: a record appended without an ACK may exist and is replayed, but the fixture does not require it (see write-without-ack). surfaced_to_user is unmeasured because no source or test fixes a user-visible surface for a step left open by a process kill; the Android tombstone notification is a plan-level addition, not a Swift behaviour.
